query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name; PRAGMA table_info(<each table>); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <each table>
result: 8 tables with opaque names: tab01=79851 rows, tab02=174285, tab03=303155, tab04=11102, tab05=91966, tab06=1032, tab07=40325, tab08=38930. All column names are opaque identifiers (fld001..fld051). Declared foreign keys link tab01/tab02/tab03/tab04/tab05/tab08 to tab07 (user identifiers) and to tab05 (post identifiers).
validation_method: read-only sqlite3 inspection of sqlite_master, PRAGMA table_info and per-table row counts

query: SELECT fld015, COUNT(*) FROM tab05 GROUP BY fld015 ORDER BY 2 DESC
result: 2=47755, 1=42912, 5=640, 4=639, 6=9, 3=6, 7=5. Value 1 rows carry titles, tags, view counts and answer counts; value 2 rows carry a non-null parent post identifier pointing at a question.
validation_method: grouped counts plus null-pattern comparison across post kinds

query: SELECT fld050, COUNT(*) FROM tab08 GROUP BY fld050 ORDER BY fld050
SELECT fld050, COUNT(*), SUM(fld002 IS NOT NULL) FROM tab08 GROUP BY fld050; SELECT SUM(fld002 IS NULL), COUNT(DISTINCT fld002) FROM tab08
result: Non-null caster identifier only for vote type 5 (3365 of 3365) and vote type 8 (60 of 60). Vote types 1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 15 and 16 have zero non-null casters. Overall 35505 of 38930 rows have a null caster; only 509 distinct users are attributed. A left join from these values to the user table produced 0 orphans.
validation_method: grouped null counts and foreign-key orphan check

query: SELECT fld001, fld039, fld045, fld046 FROM tab07 WHERE fld001=24; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld020=24; SELECT fld050, COUNT(*) FROM tab08 WHERE fld002=24 GROUP BY fld050

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab02 c JOIN tab07 u ON c.fld002=u.fld001 WHERE c.fld009<>u.fld039; SELECT SUM(fld002 IS NULL), SUM(fld009 IS NULL) FROM tab02
result: 0 mismatches: wherever the comment-level display name is non-null it equals the joined user account display name. The comment-level display name is null for 171454 of 174285 comments; the author identifier is null for 2835. Sample: the comment 'thank you user93!' has author id 58 and joined display name 'Preets'.

query: SELECT fld023 FROM tab05 WHERE fld023 LIKE '%<humor>%' LIMIT 5; SELECT fld034 FROM tab06 WHERE fld034 LIKE '%bayes%'

validation_method: string inspection of representative values in both encodings

query: SELECT fld034, fld035 FROM tab06 WHERE fld034 IN ('humor','bayesian'); SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld023 LIKE '%<humor>%'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld023 LIKE '%<bayesian>%'
